title: Chronos Enables Code Agents to Reason over Software Evolution
title_zh: Chronos 使代码智能体能够推理软件演化过程

paragraphs.en: Historical pull requests record the design decisions, compatibility constraints, and implementation patterns behind a codebase’s current state. Experience relevant to a new task can span related changes whose descriptions emphasize different concerns. We introduce Chronos, a test-time framework that makes this connected history available to large language model (LLM)-based code agents. Chronos distills merged pull requests into structured experience cards and connects them through a typed graph of code-level, developer-intent, and organizational relations. Semantic search identifies entry cards, and weighted multi-hop expansion retrieves connected changes for selective reading. The same memory guides candidate generation and patch selection: a patch-focused change agent and a validation-strategy agent each develop a patch, and an evolution steward consults history to select between them. On SWE-Bench Verified, the full workflow improves SWE-Agent across all six evaluated LLM backbones, raising the mean resolution rate from 69.2% to 72.9% and reaching 79.8% with MiniMax M2.5. With the same backbone, it raises resolution rates from 48.3% to 51.7% on SWE-Bench Pro and from 41.0% to 43.5% on FEA-Bench Lite. Both experience-guided single-agent variants also outperform the base agent. In a human evaluation on 100 tasks with ten cards retrieved per task, graph-grounded retrieval increases the mean number of useful cards from 1.24 to 2.87 over flat semantic retrieval. These results demonstrate the value of PR relations for retrieving useful repository experience and of the evaluated workflows for applying that experience during patch generation and selection.
paragraphs.zh: 历史拉取请求记录了代码库当前状态背后的设计决策、兼容性约束和实现模式。 与新任务相关的经验可能涵盖一系列相关变更，而这些变更的描述会强调不同的关注点。 我们提出了 Chronos，一个测试时框架，它使大型语言模型（LLM） 기반 代码智能体能够访问这种连贯的历史记录。 Chronos 将已合并的拉取请求提炼为结构化的经验卡片，并通过一个包含代码级、开发者意图和组织关系的类型化图将它们连接起来。 语义搜索可识别入口卡片，而加权多跳扩展则检索出相关的变更以供选择性阅读。 同一记忆机制也指导候选生成和补丁选择：一个以补丁为中心的变更智能体和一个验证策略智能体各自生成一个补丁，再由一个演化协调者参考历史记录在两者之间做出选择。 在 SWE-Bench Verified 数据集上，完整的工作流程在所有六个评估的 LLM 基础模型上提升了 SWE-Agent 的性能，将平均解决率从 69.2% 提高到 72.9%，使用 MiniMax M2.5 时则达到了 79.8%。 在相同的基础模型下，它在 SWE-Bench Pro 上的解决率从 48.3% 提升至 51.7%，在 FEA-Bench Lite 上则从 41.0% 提升至 43.5%。 两种由经验引导的单智能体变体也优于基础智能体。 在一项涉及 100 个任务的人类评估中，每个任务检索十张卡片，基于图的检索使有用卡片的平均数量从 1.24 增加到 2.87，优于平面的语义检索。 这些结果证明了拉取请求关系在检索有用仓库经验方面的价值，以及所评估的工作流程在补丁生成和选择过程中应用这些经验的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Code agents based on large language models perform repository-level software engineering tasks by inspecting source code, invoking tools, and producing patches. SWE-Bench established a common evaluation setting for real-world issue resolution ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , and frameworks such as SWE-Agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) provide tool interfaces for repository exploration and code modification. Software maintenance also encompasses feature implementation ( Li et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) , compatibility maintenance through code migration ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ) , and refactoring ( Gautam et al., 2025 ; Thillen et al., 2026 ) . Across these tasks, a successful change must satisfy the behavioral requirements and constraints accumulated as a codebase evolves.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型的智能体通过检查源代码、调用工具并生成补丁来执行仓库级别的软件工程任务。 SWE-Bench 为现实世界中的问题修复建立了通用的评估环境（Jimenez 等人，2024），而像 SWE-Agent（Yang 等人，2024）这样的框架则提供了用于仓库探索和代码修改的工具接口。 软件维护还包括功能实现（Li 等人，2025；Zhou 等人，2026）、通过代码迁移进行兼容性维护（Liu 等人，2025；Cheng 等人，2025）以及重构（Gautam 等人，2025；Thillen 等人，2026）。 在这些任务中，一次成功的变更必须满足随着代码库演化而积累的行为要求和约束。

paragraphs.en: The current source tree exposes how a system behaves; its development history records the decisions that shaped that behavior. Pull requests (PRs) connect code changes with the problems that motivated them, review discussions, and implementation choices. This context can explain why a compatibility branch exists, which assumption an earlier fix corrected, or how a component was extended after its introduction. Experienced developers draw on this knowledge when planning new changes. For a code agent, retrieving the relevant history provides access to prior reasoning that would otherwise have to be reconstructed from the current code.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的源代码树揭示了系统的行为方式；其开发历史则记录了塑造这种行为的决策过程。 拉取请求（PR）将代码变更与驱动这些变更的问题、评审讨论以及实现选择联系起来。 这些背景信息可以解释为何存在某个兼容性分支、早期修复解决了哪个假设，或者某个组件在引入后是如何扩展的。 经验丰富的开发者在规划新的变更时，会利用这些知识。 对于代码智能体而言，获取相关历史信息意味着能够访问先前的推理过程，否则这些推理必须从当前代码中重新构建。

paragraphs.en: Recent work makes such experience accessible through memory and retrieval. MemGovern ( Wang et al., 2026a ) organizes human repair experience into structured cards that agents search and browse, while Repository Memory ( Wang et al., 2026b ) uses a target repository’s commits and linked issues to support localization. These approaches make prior solutions available through task-conditioned search and selective inspection. The organization of that context poses a further challenge: experience relevant to one task can span changes whose descriptions emphasize different concerns. An initial repair, a subsequent extension, and a related backport may jointly explain how to adapt a component, although only one strongly matches the current query. Ranking records solely by their similarity to the query leaves these relationships outside the retrieval decision.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究通过记忆和检索使这类经验变得可用。 MemGovern（Wang 等，2026a）将人类的修复经验组织成结构化卡片，供智能体搜索和浏览；而 Repository Memory（Wang 等，2026b）则利用目标存储库的提交记录和相关联的问题来支持定位。 这些方法通过任务相关的搜索和选择性检查，使过往的解决方案得以使用。 这种上下文的组织方式带来了进一步的挑战：与某项任务相关的经验可能涉及多个变更，而这些变更的描述会强调不同的关注点。 一次初始修复、一次后续扩展以及一次相关的回传可能共同解释了如何调整某个组件，尽管其中只有一个与当前查询高度匹配。 如果仅根据记录与查询的相似度进行排序，这些关系就会被排除在检索决策之外。

paragraphs.en: Our central insight is that relations between historical changes provide a second retrieval signal for repository experience . PRs expose this signal through repeated changes to the same files, development on newly introduced components, explicit references, and shared workflow context. These observable relations make connected changes discoverable even when their descriptions emphasize different symptoms or development objectives. The technical challenge is to follow these relations from semantic entry points, recover additional historical evidence, and prioritize it within a compact shortlist that an agent can inspect.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心见解是，历史变化之间的关系为存储库经验提供了第二个检索信号。 通过重复修改相同文件、对新增组件的开发、显式引用以及共享的工作流程上下文，PRs 暴露了这一信号。 这些可观察的关系使得相互关联的变化即便在描述中强调不同症状或开发目标时也能被发现。 技术挑战在于从语义入口点追踪这些关系，恢复额外的历史证据，并在智能体能够检查的紧凑候选列表中对其排序。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Chronos, a test-time framework that turns a repository’s PR history into searchable, graph-structured software-evolution experience. Its memory layer has two complementary parts. Four-field experience cards capture the Summary , Signals , Motivation , and Solution of each historical change. A typed evolution graph connects those cards through code-level continuity, developer intent, and organizational context. At task time, semantic search locates entry-point cards, weighted multi-hop expansion finds connected PRs, and the agent selectively reads the resulting experience. The graph determines which connected changes become candidates for inspection, while the cards explain the rationale and implementation logic needed to apply their experience.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Chronos，一个测试时框架，它能够将代码库的拉取请求（PR）历史转化为可搜索、具有图结构的软件演化经验。 其记忆层包含两个互补的部分。 四字段经验卡记录了每次历史变更的摘要、信号、动机和解决方案。 一种带类型的演化图通过代码层面的连续性、开发者的意图以及组织背景将这些卡片连接起来。 在任务执行时，语义搜索会定位入口点卡片，加权多跳扩展会找到相关的拉取请求，而智能体则会选择性读取由此获得的经验。 该图决定了哪些相关的变更会成为待检查的候选项，而卡片则解释了应用这些经验所需的理由和实现逻辑。

Our full resolution workflow uses a patch-focused change agent to investigate design intent and a validation-strategy agent to investigate behavioral mismatches and regression risks. Each produces a candidate patch. An evolution steward independently consults the memory and current source code to select the final candidate. Repository experience thus informs two decisions: how to implement a change and which proposed implementation best addresses the task. The retrieval service remains separate from these roles and integrates with existing agent tool interfaces without model fine-tuning.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Chronos on SWE-Bench Verified ( Chowdhury et al., 2024 ) , SWE-Bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , and FEA-Bench Lite ( Li et al., 2025 ) . On SWE-Bench Verified, the full workflow improves SWE-Agent across all six evaluated LLM backbones, raising the mean resolution rate from 69.2% to 72.9% and reaching 79.8% with MiniMax M2.5. With the same backbone, Chronos raises resolution rates from 48.3% to 51.7% on SWE-Bench Pro and from 41.0% to 43.5% on FEA-Bench Lite. The two single-agent variants reach 78.4% and 77.8%, compared with 76.4% for the base agent, showing that the experience-guided strategies also improve resolution when each produces a single candidate. In a human evaluation on 100 sampled tasks, graph-grounded retrieval raises the average number of useful cards among ten returned cards from 1.24 to 2.87 and the fraction of tasks receiving useful experience from 68% to 89%, compared with flat semantic retrieval. The benchmark results establish gains for the evaluated resolution workflows, while the retrieval study shows that PR relations help recover useful historical context within a fixed retrieval depth. Figure 1 places the system results alongside representative agent configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SWE-Bench Verified（Chowdhury 等人，2024）、SWE-Bench Pro（Deng 等人，2025）和 FEA-Bench Lite（Li 等人，2025）上对 Chronos 进行了评估。 在 SWE-Bench Verified 上，完整的工作流程在所有六个评估的 LLM 基础模型上均提升了 SWE-Agent 的性能，将平均问题解决率从 69.2% 提高到 72.9%，使用 MiniMax M2.5 时更是达到了 79.8%。 在使用相同基础模型的情况下，Chronos 在 SWE-Bench Pro 上将问题解决率从 48.3% 提升至 51.7%，在 FEA-Bench Lite 上则从 41.0% 提升至 43.5%。 两种单智能体变体的问题解决率分别达到了 78.4% 和 77.8%，高于基础智能体的 76.4%，这表明即使每个智能体仅生成一个候选方案，经验引导策略仍能提升问题解决能力。 在 100 个抽样任务上进行的人类评估显示，与平面语义检索相比，基于图的检索将十张返回卡片中有效卡片的平均数量从 1.24 提升至 2.87，并使获得有效经验的任务比例从 68% 提升至 89%。 基准测试结果表明了所评估的问题解决工作流程取得了性能提升，而检索研究则表明，PR 关系有助于在固定的检索深度内恢复有用的历史上下文信息。 图 1 将系统结果与代表性的智能体配置进行了对比展示。

paragraphs.en: Chronos turns repository history into experience that agents can retrieve while investigating a new coding task. Its two stages separate memory construction from task-time use (Figure 2 ). The memory layer distills historical PRs into cards describing the rationale and implementation logic of individual changes, then connects those cards through code-level, developer-intent, and organizational relations. At task time, semantic search locates relevant cards and graph expansion retrieves connected changes beyond the semantic shortlist. Agents read selected cards to guide candidate generation and patch selection.
paragraphs.zh: Chronos 将仓库历史转化为智能体在研究新编码任务时能够调用的经验。 其两个阶段将记忆构建与任务时的使用分离开来（图 2）。 记忆层将历史上的 PR 提炼为卡片，描述单个变更的原理和实现逻辑，然后通过代码级、开发者意图和组织关系将这些卡片连接起来。 在任务执行时，语义搜索会定位相关卡片，而图扩展则会检索语义候选列表之外的关联变更。 智能体通过阅读选定的卡片来指导候选生成和补丁选择。

paragraphs.en: We use merged PRs as historical evolution events and convert each event into a compact, transferable experience card. A raw PR record mixes code diffs and review discussion with process updates and repository-specific references. Its rationale and implementation logic are dispersed across these sources. Distillation consolidates that reasoning into a consistent representation that an agent can inspect during its investigation of the current task.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将合并后的 PR 视为历史演化事件，并将每个事件转换为简洁且可传递的经验卡。 原始的 PR 记录混合了代码差异和评审讨论内容，以及流程更新和特定仓库的引用信息。 其设计原理和实现逻辑分散在这些来源中。 提炼过程将这些推理整合为一种一致的表达形式，智能体可以在研究当前任务时进行查看。

paragraphs.en: We distill each PR with Qwen3.5-Plus ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) into a fixed four-field card. The fields divide the information needed to find a relevant change from the reasoning needed to adapt it: Summary states the evolution task and its high-level resolution in one or two sentences and serves as the embedding anchor; Signals supplies 12–20 concrete retrieval cues covering symptoms or capability gaps, affected component types, APIs, and semantic variants; Motivation explains why the prior software state was inadequate, tracing triggering inputs or capability gaps to the existing behavior; and Solution presents the actionable change logic as a development decision, one to three short annotated code patterns, and three to five implementation pitfalls. Search uses the compact Summary and exposes Signals for relevance assessment; reading the full card supplies Motivation and Solution for implementation reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将每个 PR 通过 Qwen3.5-Plus（Qwen Team，2026）提炼为一张固定的四字段卡片。 这些字段将查找相关变更所需的信息与适配该变更所需的推理区分开来：摘要用一到两句话说明演化任务及其高层次解决方案，并作为嵌入锚点；信号提供 12–20 个具体的检索线索，涵盖症状或能力缺口、受影响的组件类型、API 和语义变体；动机解释为何先前的软件状态不足，追溯触发输入或能力缺口与现有行为之间的关系；而解决方案则以开发决策的形式呈现可执行の変更逻辑，包括一到三个带注释的简短代码模式以及三到五个实施陷阱。 搜索功能使用简洁的摘要并暴露信号以进行相关性评估；阅读完整卡片则可获得用于实施推理的动机和解决方案。

paragraphs.en: The distillation prompt takes the PR title, body, discussion, and patch as input and adapts its analysis to bug fixes, feature additions, refactorings, and performance changes. It removes non-technical content and incidental identifiers, including repository and user names, URLs, commit hashes, and version numbers. File paths are allowed only inside Solution code snippets. The original PR identifier links the resulting card to its changed-file metadata and graph node, preserving the source context needed for retrieval. Full prompt templates appear in the supplementary material.

paragraphs.en: The card and its metadata support different uses of the historical record. The card explains why a change was needed and how it was implemented, so a task query can match its technical concepts without reproducing the source PR’s vocabulary. The metadata locates that change within repository development and connects it to earlier and later work. Source identity remains accessible through the PR identifier and linked metadata, even when incidental identifiers have been removed from the embedded text. A card can therefore be discovered through its Summary or through a relation to another PR. After either route, Motivation and Solution help the agent judge whether the underlying assumption and development decision apply to the current task, and how the experience should be adapted to the current code.
paragraphs.zh: 该卡片及其元数据支持对历史记录的多种用途。 该卡片说明了为何需要进行变更以及变更是如何实施的，因此任务查询可以匹配其技术概念，而无需重复源 PR 的词汇。 元数据可在仓库开发中定位该变更，并将其与更早和后续的工作联系起来。 即使嵌入式文本中已移除了附带标识符，通过 PR 标识符和关联的元数据仍然可以访问源身份。 因此，可以通过其摘要或通过与其他 PR 的关系来发现一张卡片。 无论通过哪种途径，动机和解决方案都有助于智能体判断其底层的假设和开发决策是否适用于当前任务，以及应如何将相关经验适应到当前代码中。

paragraphs.en: We organize these edges into three tiers by evidential strength. Tier 1 (Code Evolution, weight 1.0 to 1.5) captures directly observable code-level facts: repeated modification of highly overlapping files or continued development on newly introduced files. Tier 2 (Developer Intent, weight 0.7 to 1.05) encodes explicit intent and short-horizon workflow continuity, including cross-PR references, backports, and same-author follow-ups within nearby directories. Tier 3 (Organizational/Social, weight 0.3 to 0.45) covers indirect project-process metadata such as shared reviewers, milestones, labels, and comment mentions, which remain informative but are typically noisier. The traversal weights give larger bonuses to code and workflow continuity and smaller bonuses to broader organizational associations. All detected relations participate in the same bounded expansion; their weights influence candidate scores rather than imposing a fixed traversal order. We use these hand-specified priors throughout the evaluated settings. Section 5.2 discusses their role in the memory representation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据证据强度将这些边划分为三个层级。 第一层级（代码演化，权重为 1.0 至 1.5）捕捉可直接观察到的代码级事实：高度重叠文件的重复修改，或对新增文件的持续开发。 第二层级（开发者意图，权重为 0.7 至 1.05）编码了明确的意图和短期工作流连续性，包括跨 PR 的引用、回迁操作以及同一作者在相邻目录中的后续操作。 第三层级（组织/社交，权重为 0.3 至 0.45）涵盖了间接的项目流程元数据，例如共享的评审者、里程碑、标签和评论提及；这些信息仍然具有参考价值，但通常噪声更多。 遍历权重会赋予代码和工作流连续性更高的加成，而对更广泛的组织关联则给予较低的加成。 所有检测到的关系都参与相同的有界扩展；它们的权重会影响候选项的得分，而非强制规定固定的遍历顺序。 我们在所有评估设置中均使用这些手动指定的先验知识。 第 5.2 节讨论了它们在记忆表示中的作用。

paragraphs.en: At task time, agents search and read software-evolution experience as their understanding of the current task develops. The graph server combines semantic entry search with relation-based expansion, retrieving connected PRs beyond the semantic shortlist. Two tool calls expose this memory through a shortlist-then-read workflow. The agent first calls graph_search to obtain a small set of historical PR candidates, then calls graph_read on those whose experience appears relevant. Algorithm 1 summarizes the bounded retrieval procedure and the filters applied during expansion.
paragraphs.zh: 在任务执行期间，随着智能体对当前任务的理解逐步加深，它会搜索并阅读软件演化经验。 图服务器将语义条目搜索与基于关系的关系扩展相结合，从而检索到超出语义候选列表的关联 PR。 两次工具调用通过“先列出候选项、再读取”的工作流程暴露了这些记忆。 智能体首先调用 graph_search 获取一组历史 PR 候选项，然后对其中经验看似相关的 PR 调用 graph_read。 算法 1 总结了有界检索过程以及在扩展过程中应用的筛选条件。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval is scoped to the current task instance. The server derives the repository from the instance identifier and uses the task PR’s creation time as the cutoff. The same scope applies to semantic entry selection and graph expansion. A PR is excluded when its recorded creation or merge time is at or after the cutoff. Filtering both stages prevents expansion from reintroducing a later change through an otherwise eligible entry point. Optional filename constraints select PRs that touch an exact path or a matching path suffix; they constrain both returned semantic candidates and traversed neighbors. Queries without filenames allow broader search within the task repository. Filtering the finite semantic candidate pool can yield fewer than K K entries even when additional eligible PRs exist elsewhere in the index.

paragraphs.en: Each frontier state carries the current PR, the path used to reach it, the originating semantic score, and the accumulated edge-weight bonus. Expansion preserves the entry score while updating the path length and graph bonus in Equation 2 . A node already on the current path is skipped, so a cycle cannot accumulate weight by repeatedly revisiting the same PR. The server records each newly reached candidate and updates its record when a path improves the stored score. Traversal stops when no frontier remains or the hop limit is reached. In our implementation, each subsequent frontier is capped at B = 200 B=200 states. This limits how many states continue through densely connected regions, prioritizing states by their nodes’ highest scores among the explored paths.

paragraphs.en: Relation types remain distinct during traversal. Because 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is a multigraph, the same ordered pair of PRs can be connected by several edge types. Each outgoing typed edge supplies an alternative extension of the current path, and Equation 2 uses the weight of that edge. The relation bonus therefore sums weights along a path, rather than summing all metadata associations between each pair of adjacent PRs. For parallel edges extending the same frontier state, the larger weight produces the higher candidate score when the entry relevance is positive. The stored maximum retains that score, while the PR still occupies one result position. Different forms of historical evidence thus provide alternative retrieval routes without accumulating bonuses for several relation types on the same connection. Multi-hop bonuses require traversing successive PRs within the eligible historical neighborhood.

paragraphs.en: The full workflow generates two candidates in separate agent runs, then selects between them through an independent review informed by repository history. Both candidate agents receive the current task and repository. paragraphs.en: Evolution steward. For distinct, non-empty candidate patches C x C_{x} and C y C_{y} , the steward receives the task description and both diffs. It analyzes each patch’s modifications, treatment of the root cause, consistency with historical experience, and missed or newly introduced edge cases. The decision criterion is logical correctness, excluding patch length, style, and comment density. Calling choose_patch x or choose_patch y records the verdict and ends the session. paragraphs.en: Historical experience informs a different decision at each stage. During generation, it helps an agent determine what to change and which behavior to preserve. During selection, the candidate diffs make those questions concrete: the steward compares proposed modifications with relevant historical rationale and examines whether that rationale applies to the affected code. Its independent search can use the candidate content to guide retrieval beyond the cards consulted by either generator. The final choice is grounded in the current task and source code, with history supplying development constraints for comparing the two available implementations.

paragraphs.en: We integrate Chronos’s structured software-evolution experience and graph-grounded search into SWE-Agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) and compare the resulting workflow with vanilla SWE-Agent. paragraphs.en: Unless otherwise noted, each agent run has a limit of 250 steps, a cost budget of $1.5, and a context window of 200k tokens. The full workflow includes two candidate-generation runs and invokes the steward for distinct, non-empty candidates, as specified in Table 2 . The graph server runs as a persistent service, with K = 5 K=5 semantic entry points and H = 3 H=3 expansion hops. Each query returns a shortlist of at most ten experience cards. On SWE-Bench Verified, we evaluate GPT-5 Mini, Claude 4.5 Haiku, Gemini 3 Flash, Kimi K2.5, Qwen3-Max, and MiniMax M2.5. The two transfer benchmarks use MiniMax M2.5, the strongest evaluated backbone on SWE-Bench Verified.

paragraphs.en: We conduct an internal expert annotation study to assess whether retrieved cards provide useful guidance for the current task. We randomly sample 100 SWE-Bench Verified instances and retrieve the top-ten cards for each task under Random, Embedding, and Chronos. Random samples cards uniformly from the knowledge base, Embedding ranks cards by cosine similarity, and Chronos uses graph-grounded search. All methods use the same task sample and retrieval depth.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开展了一项内部专家标注研究，以评估检索出的卡片是否为当前任务提供了有用的指导。 我们随机抽取了 100 个 SWE-Bench Verified 实例，并在 Random、Embedding 和 Chronos 模式下为每个任务检索出排名前十的卡片。 Random 模式从知识库中均匀地采样卡片，Embedding 模式通过余弦相似度对卡片进行排序，而 Chronos 模式则使用基于图的搜索方法。 所有方法均使用相同的任务样本和检索深度。

paragraphs.en: Two members of our research team with professional software-engineering experience independently label each retrieved card using the task description and all four card fields: Summary, Signals, Motivation, and Solution. A card is useful when it identifies a transferable implementation pattern, failure mode, compatibility constraint, design rationale, or validation strategy that can directly help produce or check a patch for the current task. The remaining cards are not useful ; topical similarity or a matching identifier alone does not establish actionable guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究团队中拥有专业软件工程经验的两位成员，会依据任务描述以及所有四个卡片字段——摘要、信号、动机和解决方案——独立地为每张检索到的卡片添加标签。 当一张卡片能够识别出可迁移的实现模式、失效模式、兼容性约束、设计依据或验证策略，并且这些内容能直接帮助生成或检查当前任务的补丁时，这张卡片就是有用的。 其余的卡片并无用处；仅凭主题相似性或匹配标识符本身，并不能构成具有操作性的指导。

paragraphs.en: SWE-Bench Verified. Table 4 reports resolution rates across six LLM backbones. The full Chronos workflow improves SWE-Agent on all six, raising the mean resolution rate from 69.2% to 72.9%, a gain of 3.7 3.7 percentage points (pp). Qwen3-Max gains + 6.2 +6.2 pp, and the other backbones gain + 2.8 +2.8 pp to + 3.6 +3.6 pp. Gains occur with both the lowest-scoring base configuration, GPT-5 Mini, and the highest-scoring one, MiniMax M2.5, showing that the workflow improves performance across the evaluated range of backbones. The analyses below examine run-to-run stability, integration with different scaffolds, and the contributions of candidate generation and retrieval.

paragraphs.en: SWE-Bench Pro and FEA-Bench Lite. With MiniMax M2.5, Chronos raises the resolution rate from 48.3% to 51.7% ( + 3.4 +3.4 pp) on SWE-Bench Pro and from 41.0% to 43.5% ( + 2.5 +2.5 pp) on FEA-Bench Lite (Table 5 ). paragraphs.en: We repeated the full Chronos configuration with the SWE-Agent scaffold and MiniMax M2.5 five times over all 500 SWE-Bench Verified instances. The graph, retrieval parameters, prompts, step limits, and per-agent cost limits remain fixed across runs; backbone sampling varies between repetitions. The resolution rates are 79.8%, 80.0%, 80.6%, 79.6%, and 80.0%, giving a mean of 80.0%, a sample standard deviation of 0.37pp, and a standard error of 0.17pp. The 95% Student’s t t interval for this configuration’s mean is [ 79.5 % , 80.5 % ] [79.5\%,80.5\%] . The five runs span 1.0pp, and the lowest result, 79.6%, remains 3.2pp above the reported SWE-Agent reference of 76.4%.

paragraphs.en: The removal losses also distinguish relation coverage from retrieval value. In Table 1 , follows has the broadest reported node coverage, yet removing precedes produces a larger loss in Useful. Coverage describes how widely a relation occurs in the stored graph, whereas removal loss measures its effect on useful cards returned for the evaluated queries. A frequent relation need not provide the most useful route for a particular task. Removing an edge type can change both which PRs are reachable and which explored paths determine their scores. Each bar therefore measures the effect of removing one relation type from the full graph; the losses are not additive shares of a fixed total. Their ordering reflects the retrieval value of the relation types in the presence of the remaining graph structure.

paragraphs.en: The evaluated integrations show that the same repository memory can support both single-candidate agents and a workflow that generates and selects between candidates. The same search and read interfaces serve SWE-Agent and mini-SWE-Agent, separating historical memory from the scaffold responsible for repository interaction. Across benchmarks, the card schema, graph-construction rules, and retrieval procedure are shared, while the historical content belongs to each target repository. The gains on issue resolution and feature implementation show the value of separating reusable development knowledge from the agents that apply it, without requiring model fine-tuning.

paragraphs.en: Historical relevance depends on both what a change describes and how it relates to other development work. Connected PRs can address different symptoms or objectives and therefore occupy different positions in a semantic ranking. Graph expansion brings their shared code, explicit references, follow-up work, and workflow context into candidate discovery. These relations determine which additional cards the server retrieves. The agent then uses the cards’ motivation and solution to judge whether the historical reasoning applies to the current code.
paragraphs.zh: 历史相关性既取决于变更所描述的内容，也取决于它与其他开发工作的关联方式。 相互关联的 PR 可能针对不同的问题或目标，因此在语义排序中占据不同的位置。 图结构扩展会将它们共享的代码、显式引用、后续工作以及工作流程上下文纳入候选项的发现过程中。 这些关系决定了服务器会检索哪些额外的卡片。 随后，智能体将利用这些卡片的动机和解决方案，判断历史推理是否适用于当前代码。

sents.en: Historical relevance depends on both what a change describes and how it relates to other development work.

sents.en: These relations determine which additional cards the server retrieves.
sents.zh: 这些关系决定了服务器会检索哪些额外的卡片。

sents.en: The agent then uses the cards’ motivation and solution to judge whether the historical reasoning applies to the current code.
sents.zh: 随后，智能体将利用这些卡片的动机和解决方案，判断历史推理是否适用于当前代码。

paragraphs.en: The retrieval parameters control different parts of this online work. At the default K = 5 K=5 , semantic search requests up to 50 index candidates before filtering, and the final shortlist contains at most ten PRs. The hop limit H H bounds the distance from a semantic entry, while the frontier limit B B bounds the number of states that continue to the next hop. Expanding a state still requires inspecting its outgoing edges, so neighborhood density affects traversal work even when H H and B B are fixed. The result limit controls how much candidate metadata reaches the agent. Subsequent read calls add full cards to the context, with the number of calls determined by the investigation. Graph exploration, shortlist size, and full-card reading therefore incur different costs, allowing the server to search more history than the agent ultimately reads.
paragraphs.zh: 检索参数控制着这项在线工作的不同部分。 在默认设置 K = 5 时，语义搜索请求会先筛选多达 50 个索引候选项，最终短名单最多包含十个 PR。 跳数限制 H 约束了从某个语义条目出发的距离，而前沿限制 B 则约束了继续进入下一跳的状态数量。 扩展一个状态仍然需要检查其出边，因此即使 H 和 B 固定不变，邻域密度仍会影响遍历工作量。 结果限制控制着有多少候选元数据会传递到智能体。 随后的读取调用会将完整卡片添加到上下文中，而调用次数由调查过程决定。 因此，图探索、短名单大小和完整卡片的读取会产生不同的成本，这使得服务器能够搜索比智能体最终读取更多的历史记录。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation covers six backbones on SWE-Bench Verified and MiniMax M2.5 on the two transfer benchmarks. Repeated-run statistics describe the full MiniMax configuration; the baseline and remaining configurations use single runs. The single-agent variants combine graph retrieval with role-specific prompting, so their gains over SWE-Agent reflect that combination. paragraphs.en: Repository history records implementation patterns, constraints, and rationales that are often revisited during maintenance. Chronos makes these records searchable when an agent develops or reviews a new change. Retrieved experience supplies hypotheses and constraints for investigating current code, connecting repository-history mining to automated code modification. Memory contributes prior development knowledge to this process, while tests and code review assess the resulting patches.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库历史记录记录了实现模式、约束条件和设计依据，这些内容在维护期间常常会被重新审视。 当智能体开发或审查新的变更时，Chronos 使这些记录变得可搜索。 检索到的经验为当前代码的探索提供了假设和约束条件，从而将仓库历史挖掘与自动化代码修改连接起来。 记忆为这一过程贡献了先前的开发知识，而测试和代码审查则对由此产生的补丁进行评估。

paragraphs.en: The reusable unit is a development decision together with the conditions that motivated it. A historical Solution describes an implementation in an earlier software state, while Motivation explains the behavioral gap or assumption that made the implementation appropriate. Reading them together helps an agent determine which parts of the experience transfer to the current code. Relations connect that decision to subsequent development on the same files or to explicitly linked work, extending the historical context available for inspection. Repository history thus becomes a connected record of evolving requirements and implementation choices. This representation supports reasoning about the constraints a change must preserve and the rationale for modifying the code, as well as the concrete implementation itself.
paragraphs.zh: 可重用单元是一项开发决策，同时也是促成该决策的条件。 历史解决方案描述了早期软件状态中的实现方式，而动机则解释了促使该实现变得合理的行为差异或假设。 将二者结合阅读有助于智能体确定经验中哪些部分可以迁移到当前代码中。 关系将这一决策与后续对相同文件的开发工作，或与明确关联的工作连接起来，从而扩展可供审查的历史背景。 因此，仓库历史成为不断演变的业务需求和实现选择的连贯记录。 这种表示方式有助于推理变更必须保留的约束条件、修改代码的依据，以及具体的实现本身。

paragraphs.en: Automated program repair has progressed from search-based methods ( Le Goues et al., 2012 ; Kim et al., 2013 ) and sequence-to-sequence models ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Lutellier et al., 2020 ) to interactive LLM-based repair. Feedback-driven methods ( Yin et al., 2024 ; Xia and Zhang, 2024 ) use execution signals across turns, while ReduceFix ( Yang et al., 2026 ) reduces test inputs while preserving failure-inducing behavior to guide patch generation. AutoCodeRover ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , and Trae Agent ( Gao et al., 2025 ) support repository exploration and code modification. PlayCoder ( Peng et al., 2026 ) combines repository-aware GUI code generation with interactive testing and iterative repair. Agentless ( Xia et al., 2025 ) simplifies the workflow, while SWE-RL ( Wei et al., 2025 ) and Kimi ( Kimi Team et al., 2025 ) improve models through reinforcement-learning-based post-training.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化程序修复已从基于搜索的方法（Le Goues 等人，2012；Kim 等人，2013）和序列到序列模型（Chen 等人，2021；Lutellier 等人，2020）发展为交互式 LLM 基础上的修复方法。 反馈驱动的方法（Yin 等人，2024；Xia 和 Zhang，2024）利用多轮交互中的执行信号，而 ReduceFix（Yang 等人，2026）则在保留导致失败的行为的同时减少测试输入，以指导补丁生成。 AutoCodeRover（Zhang 等人，2024）、OpenHands（Wang 等人，2025b）和 Trae Agent（Gao 等人，2025）支持仓库探索和代码修改。 PlayCoder（Peng 等人，2026）将具备仓库感知能力的 GUI 代码生成与交互式测试及迭代修复相结合。 Agentless（Xia 等人，2025）简化了工作流程，而 SWE-RL（Wei 等人，2025）和 Kimi（Kimi Team 等人，2025）则通过基于强化学习的后训练来改进模型。

paragraphs.en: SWE-Bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) evaluates repository-level issue resolution, while SWE-Bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , SWE-PolyBench ( Rashid et al., 2025 ) , Multi-SWE-bench ( Zan et al., 2025 ) , and SWE-rebench ( Badertdinov et al., 2025 ) extend evaluation to harder tasks, multiple programming languages, or continually collected instances. Chronos complements these agents with historical PR experience for candidate generation and selection.

paragraphs.en: Code graphs represent program structure for repository exploration and generation. LocAgent ( Chen et al., 2025b ) navigates files, classes, and functions through dependency relations for code localization. GraphCoder ( Liu et al., 2024 ) combines control flow and control/data dependence in statement-level graphs to retrieve code contexts for completion. CGM ( Tao et al., 2025 ) encodes code-entity semantics as node tokens and uses graph adjacency to constrain attention in a trained model. RepoDistill ( Yin et al., 2026 ) combines graph-based retrieval with learned token-budget allocation to compress repository context. Chronos uses a graph of historical PR events to discover experience about prior changes, with the retrieved cards exposed through task-time tools.
paragraphs.zh: 代码图表示程序结构，用于仓库的探索与生成。 LocAgent（Chen 等人，2025b）通过依赖关系在文件、类和函数之间导航，以实现代码定位。 GraphCoder（Liu 等人，2024）将控制流以及控制/数据依赖整合到语句级图中，以检索用于补全的代码上下文。 CGM（Tao 等人，2025）将代码实体的语义编码为节点标记，并利用图的邻接关系来约束训练模型中的注意力机制。 RepoDistill（Yin 等人，2026）将基于图的检索与学习到的标记预算分配相结合，以压缩仓库上下文。 Chronos 使用历史 PR 事件构成的图来发现过往变更的经验，并通过任务时间工具展示检索到的卡片。

paragraphs.en: Systems that reuse software-engineering history draw on several sources of experience. SWE-Exp ( Chen et al., 2025a ) and ExpeRepair ( Mu et al., 2025 ) reuse experience from agents’ own prior trajectories. MemGovern ( Wang et al., 2026a ) pools human repair experience from issues and merged patches across GitHub repositories. HAFix ( Shi et al., 2025 ) uses blame-derived context, Repository Memory ( Wang et al., 2026b ) retrieves commits and linked issues, Lingxi ( Yang et al., 2025 ) extracts procedural knowledge from earlier issues, and MemCoder ( Deng et al., 2026 ) builds intent-to-code memory from commits in the target repository. Chronos likewise draws on development history from the target repository and organizes retrieval around relations between historical PR events.
paragraphs.zh: 重用软件工程历史的系统会利用多种经验来源。 SWE-Exp（Chen 等，2025a）和 ExpeRepair（Mu 等，2025）会重用智能体自身先前轨迹中的经验。 MemGovern（Wang 等，2026a）会从 GitHub 仓库中的问题与合并后的补丁中收集人类的修复经验。 HAFix（Shi 等，2025）使用通过 blame 分析得出的上下文，Repository Memory（Wang 等，2026b）会检索提交记录与关联问题，Lingxi（Yang 等，2025）会从早期问题中提取流程知识，而 MemCoder（Deng 等，2026）则会从目标仓库的提交记录中构建意图到代码的记忆。 Chronos 同样会利用目标仓库的开发历史，并围绕历史 PR 事件之间的关系组织检索过程。

paragraphs.en: MemGovern ( Wang et al., 2026a ) is particularly close in its use of structured cards and a search-then-browse interface. Its index layer captures problem summaries and diagnostic signals, while its resolution layer stores repair reasoning. Search ranks cards by query-to-index embedding similarity, and the agent can revise queries and selectively browse their detailed contents. Chronos retains selective card reading and adds weighted expansion from semantic entry points over typed relations between PRs. Changed files, explicit references, follow-up work, reviewers, milestones, and other PR metadata provide the evidence for these links. This changes candidate discovery: a card can be retrieved through its connection to a relevant historical change as well as its own query similarity.
paragraphs.zh: MemGovern（Wang 等人，2026a）在结构化卡片的使用以及“先搜索后浏览”的界面方面尤为接近。 其索引层捕捉问题摘要和诊断信号，而解决层则存储修复推理过程。 搜索功能根据查询与索引嵌入的相似度对卡片进行排序，智能体可以修改查询并选择性浏览其详细内容。 Chronos 保留了选择性阅读卡片的功能，并增加了基于语义入口点、跨越 PR 之间类型化关系的加权扩展。 已更改的文件、明确引用、后续工作、评审员、里程碑以及其他 PR 元数据为这些关联提供了证据。 这改变了候选项的发现方式：一张卡片既可以通过它与相关历史变更的关联被检索，也可以通过其自身的查询相似度被检索。

paragraphs.en: We presented Chronos, a test-time framework that turns PR history into graph-structured software-evolution experience for code agents. Its central contribution is relational retrieval: semantic search locates relevant historical changes, and typed PR relations make connected experience available for selective reading. Structured cards supply the rationale and implementation logic used during candidate generation and patch selection.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Chronos，一个测试时框架，它可将拉取请求（PR）历史转化为图结构化的软件演化经验，供代码智能体使用。 其核心贡献是关系检索：语义搜索可定位相关的历史变更，而带有类型的 PR 关系则使关联的经验可供选择性阅读。 结构化卡片提供了在候选生成和补丁选择过程中所使用的依据与实现逻辑。

paragraphs.en: Across six backbones on SWE-Bench Verified, the full workflow raises the mean SWE-Agent resolution rate from 69.2% to 72.9% and reaches 79.8% in the strongest configuration. With MiniMax M2.5, it raises resolution rates from 48.3% to 51.7% on SWE-Bench Pro and from 41.0% to 43.5% on FEA-Bench Lite. The experience-guided single-agent variants also improve on the base agent. With ten cards retrieved per task, graph-grounded retrieval raises the average number of human-judged useful cards from 1.24 to 2.87 over flat semantic retrieval. These findings establish PR relations as a useful retrieval signal for repository memory and show how that memory can support both patch generation and selection in the evaluated workflows.
